title: Killing random motions with finite velocity
summary: In this paper, we study finite-velocity random motions subject to a killing mechanism acting at direction changes: at each change of direction, the motion is killed with a fixed probability and remains at its current position thereafter. We first consider the one-dimensional case of a standard telegraph process. We derive the exact distribution of the position at the killing time and show that it is Laplace distributed.
